characters.name: Malik Baptiste
characters.instruction: Pronounce Malik exactly muh-LEEK: 'muh' like 'uh' with an m, followed by 'leek' like the vegetable. Stress LEEK. Never pronounce it MAL-ik or MAY-lik. Pronounce Baptiste bap-TEEST.

characters.name: Nia Reynolds
characters.instruction: Pronounce Nia NEE-uh, with two syllables. Pronounce Reynolds REN-uldz.

characters.name: Julian Cross
characters.instruction: Pronounce Julian JOO-lee-un. Pronounce Cross like the English word cross.

characters.name: Simone Hart
characters.instruction: Pronounce Simone suh-MOHN, stressing MOHN. Pronounce Hart like the English word heart.

characters.name: Darius "DJ" Cole
characters.instruction: Pronounce Darius DAIR-ee-us, DJ as the letters DEE-JAY, and Cole like coal.

characters.name: Keisha Morgan
characters.instruction: Pronounce Keisha KEE-shuh. Pronounce Morgan MOR-gun.

characters.name: Imani Cole
characters.instruction: Pronounce Imani ee-MAH-nee, stressing MAH. Pronounce Cole like coal.

characters.name: Dr. Camille Brooks
characters.instruction: Pronounce Camille kuh-MEEL, stressing MEEL. Pronounce Brooks like the English plural word brooks.

characters.name: Dr. Victor Delgado
characters.instruction: Pronounce Victor VIK-ter and Delgado del-GAH-doh, stressing GAH.

characters.name: Dr. Renee Okafor
characters.instruction: Pronounce Renee ruh-NAY and Okafor oh-KAH-for, stressing KAH.

characters.name: Dr. Isaac Bennett
characters.instruction: Pronounce Isaac EYE-zik and Bennett BEN-it.

characters.name: Dr. Alana Price
characters.instruction: Pronounce Alana uh-LAH-nuh, stressing LAH. Pronounce Price like the English word price.

characters.name: Celeste Baptiste
characters.instruction: Pronounce Celeste suh-LEST and Baptiste bap-TEEST.

characters.name: Marcel Baptiste
characters.instruction: Pronounce Marcel mar-SELL and Baptiste bap-TEEST.

characters.name: Micah
characters.instruction: Pronounce Micah MY-kuh.

characters.name: Denise Reynolds
characters.instruction: Pronounce Denise duh-NEES and Reynolds REN-uldz.

characters.name: Alexis Grant
characters.instruction: Pronounce Alexis uh-LEK-sis and Grant like the English word grant.

characters.name: Elaine Carter
characters.instruction: Pronounce Elaine ih-LAYN and Carter KAR-ter.

characters.name: Ms. Alvarez
characters.instruction: Pronounce Ms. as miz and Alvarez al-VAH-rez, stressing VAH.

characters.name: Zoe
characters.instruction: Pronounce Zoe ZOH-ee, with two syllables.

characters.name: DJ's auntie
characters.instruction: Pronounce DJ's as DEE-JAYZ and auntie AN-tee.
